summary: People Inc (formerly IAC Inc), a Delaware-incorporated technology company, filed a routine Form 8-K on 2026-09-11 under Items 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits). The submission contains 131 documents, largely XBRL financial-statement tagging for fiscal years 2023-2025, with no transaction, stake, price-per-share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation disclosed. There is no special-situation event: no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, capital return, activist campaign, restructuring, or management change is described. Risk-arb angle: none; this is an administrative/current report filing only.
